records.statement: Under sigma -> R sigma R^T, beta -> R beta, omega -> det(R) R omega, the axial Krylov determinant det[omega, sigma omega, sigma^2 omega] is an O(3) scalar; the polar analogue is a pseudoscalar.

ON THE PRINCIPAL STRATUM (finite generic isotropy) the kinematic state has exactly dim(state) - 3 functionally independent SO(3) invariants: 9 for (sigma, omega, beta, DeltaOmega_k), 12 with four-acceleration, 15 with the velocity-frame split. x_C resolves one. Off-stratum the rule fails: a single vector alone has isotropy U(1) and one invariant, not zero.
Generic orbits are three-dimensional; isotropy jumps on the axisymmetric shear locus and on non-cyclic vector configurations. Separation statements are stratum-conditional.
The twelve registered v2 polynomials carry their declared parity.
sigma^3 = (tr sigma^2 / 2) sigma + (tr sigma^3 / 3) I for trace-free symmetric sigma; hence v.sigma^3.v and v.sigma^4.v reduce.
det[v, sigma v, sigma^2 v]^2 equals the Gram determinant of the Krylov chain, which is a polynomial in the five even invariants of (sigma, v).

J_sigma = sqrt(6) I3 / I2^{3/2} lies in [-1, 1]; Delta_sigma = I2^3/2 - 3 I3^2 = (I2^3/2)(1 - J^2) is exactly the discriminant of the characteristic polynomial; |J| = 1 iff repeated eigenvalue, J = 0 iff eigenvalues (lambda, -lambda, 0); J is scale-free.

At the registered witness (beta = 0) the v2 catalogue does not separate (sigma, omega) from (sigma, -omega); the axial Krylov determinant does; and the two states lie in distinct SO(3) orbits (the stabiliser of diag(1,2,-3) is COMPUTED from the commutant to be the Klein four-group, no element of which maps omega to -omega).

Catalogue v3 is the degree-bounded closure of the Gram-Krylov generating set over {beta_RM, beta_MO, A, omega} plus one Krylov determinant per vector, triple determinants, tr sigma^2, tr sigma^3 and DeltaOmega_k; parity is mechanical in (#omega + #epsilon).
The v3 catalogue separates SO(3) orbits on the principal stratum (distinct shear eigenvalues, participating vectors cyclic).
Whether v3 generates the full invariant ring (Molien/Hilbert series).
The exact beta=0, omega vs -omega witness for catalogue v2.

The Gauss-Friedmann budget functional FACTORS THROUGH the four invariants {tr sigma^2, omega^2, beta^2, DeltaOmega_k}; it therefore has exactly zero derivative along the helicity beta.omega and along every direction transverse to their common level set. Stated as a factorisation, not a polynomial grading: Omega_tilt = (1+w) Omega_m sinh^2(beta) is an even function of beta.beta, not the monomial beta^2, so the budget does depend on higher even powers and a "vanishes on degree >= 3" claim would be false.
The comparator sign vector c = (+1,-1,+1,+1) is forced by the constraint.
The anisotropic-curvature sector re-opens beyond leading EGS order within the same channels; LRS slaving coefficient exactly -1, kappa = -2/(5+3w).
For a perfect fluid (mu + p) A_a = -D_a p slaves the four-acceleration to the pressure gradient, giving A2_max_euler = (3/2)[c_s^2/(1+w)]^2 eps_g^2 for an ASSUMED gradient bound eps_g.
Radial peculiar velocities carry no vorticity; n.Omega.n = 0 exactly.
Transverse velocities re-open the vorticity sector; the 3-mode design has rank 3.
Shear memory of anisotropic stress; registered scalar closure differs from the exact linearised law.
King-Ellis tilted-congruence kinematics, exact vorticity classification, rotating perfect-fluid development with the double Omega_k = 0 obstruction.
{u : rho_A(u) <= 1} = A for the registered closed convex absorbing body.
For a product of block balls, rho_A(u) = max_j ||u_j|| / B_j.
H_lin subset A_MES implies (H_lin implies rho_MES <= 1), no converse.
For invertible anchor scaling D: rank(RD) = rank(R) and Ru = (RD)(D^-1 u).
Branch registry, geodesic re-freeze, MESb web trace and refutation.
Which points of the completed invariant space are realised by constraint-satisfying data (the K -> G lift).
The scalar-sector data-identifiable subspace of g has rank 2 under the registered leading-order channels.

Dipole alone gives rank 3 against 6 velocity parameters. A boost-only channel restores rank 6 - but only ABERRATION is a linear O(beta) channel and can do so; the kinematic quadrupole is O(beta^2) (repo-typed, frame_typed_algebra.py), contributes no linear rank about beta = 0, and about a fiducial beta_MO != 0 enters at relative amplitude O(beta) ~ 1e-3, already the WEAKLY_IDENTIFIED regime - an over-determination check, not a second linear channel. As that channel weakens, rank stays 6 while the minimum principal angle tends to zero - a state distinct from rank deficiency.
Posterior marginal equals prior marginal on a null response direction (restricted KL exactly zero).
rho of a product of sector balls is max_j s_j; exceedance E = max(rho - 1, 0).

Well-posedness table for the functional-indexed family: F_phi requires phi sign-definite AND anchored; signed and pseudoscalar functionals admit signed Q_phi and Pi_phi only; scale-free shape coordinates admit neither Q nor F.

Under (H1) a null law invariant under a reflection P that also fixes the analysis geometry, (H2) an exactly P-equivariant estimator including mask deconvolution and weighting, and (H3) P(psi_hat = 0) = 0: the law of psi_hat is symmetric about zero, hence sign ~ Bernoulli(1/2) exactly and independent of magnitude.

A nested mask ladder is a reverse martingale if and only if every rung reports the conditional expectation of the SAME full-sky target; Doob then calibrates the path by P(max |M_j| >= lambda sd(M_full)) <= 1/lambda^2.
Indicator e-values with finite-null correction; arithmetic-mean merging valid under arbitrary dependence.

When eta is not point-identified, report the envelope [inf_eta Pi_phi(c|eta), sup_eta Pi_phi(c|eta)]. Vertex enumeration over the existing vertex/recession representation returns the endpoints when the identified set is convex AND BOUNDED (no active recession direction) and the conditional map is MONOTONE, or quasi-convex for the upper endpoint AND QUASI-CONCAVE for the lower; otherwise return OPTIMIZER_REQUIRED. Bauer's maximum principle places the SUPREMUM of a quasi-convex function at an extreme point; the INFIMUM is generically interior (Pi = eta^2 on conv{-1,+1}: true inf 0 at eta = 0, vertex enumeration returns 1), and the lower envelope is the conservative endpoint.

For a testing problem whose null and alternative class are invariant under a group G, every G-invariant test statistic is a function of a maximal invariant; on the principal stratum the completed catalogue is a maximal invariant for SO(3). With registered external directions, G is their stabiliser and the maximal invariant is the catalogue augmented by relative-orientation coordinates.
SO(3) is compact hence amenable; by Hunt-Stein the best invariant test is minimax among all tests for the invariant problem.

Because the maximal invariant is a finite-dimensional coordinate (9/12/15) and the catalogue is pre-registered, the invariant test family is finite and known; look-elsewhere becomes bookkeeping over a complete catalogue.
Open-set classification with TYPE_UNIDENTIFIED and UNKNOWN_CLASS as first-class outcomes.
Preregistered held-out comparison across nine representations - the scalar x_C has rank zero and abstains on every held-out draw, while non-scalar losses drop by 0.105 to 0.301.

All six methods abstain on the confusable sum-only cell; pure-local false-global rate 0.0246 below ceiling; adding the registered finite-window depth contrast raises the minimum principal angle from 0.134 to 1.310 rad.
Response rank, single-shell degeneracy, and parameter-vs-observation duplication.
Vector-g response covariance propagation.
Anchor scaling alone is not information gain.
Single-sky sampling dispersion; multi-ell Fisher floor.

The MES anchors bound the degree-2 even invariants and, by I-3.1, the budget factors through the same four. Therefore NO MES-ANCHORED ceiling exists for a scale-free shape coordinate and no morphology statistic contributes to the budget. The firewall is about AUTHORITY, not algebraic independence: |J_sigma| <= 1 (I-2.4) is an exact algebraic bound, so an anchor on I2 does induce |tr sigma^3| <= I2^{3/2}/sqrt(6) - that bound is ALGEBRAIC, NOT ANCHORED, is saturated on the axisymmetric locus, and must never be reported as a saturation or occupancy.
One-way MES logic supplies the deterministic implication; restricted J2 supplies the condition under which the corresponding test is valid. Neither alone licenses a refutation claim.
The acceleration ceiling of I-4.1 is a statement about a declared congruence; the statistical channel key must carry congruence or two epochs' acceleration saturations become silently comparable.
Parity typing is what makes the exact sign test available; collapsing parity for convenience destroys an exact test, not merely a label.
